objective: Forensically extract the portable visual-design intelligence from gpt-image2-ppt-skills for Stage 4 of ppt-hybrid-lab. Focus on how the repository represents style identity, distilled layout grammar, content capacity, layout routing, sample approval, variation/anti-repetition, template cloning, prompt assembly, visual QA, and edit/regeneration policy. We are NOT adopting its full-slide-image-first architecture as semantic truth. Produce evidence-backed recommendations for a semantic-first editable hybrid system and proposed fields/contracts for our Visual IR and style/archetype registry.
questions: What exact structured representations exist for global style, identity anchors, density rules, variation rules, anti-repetition rules, layouts, visual signatures, content capacity, best_for/avoid_for, routing, external image slots, and reference evidence? Cite paths and fields.
How are reference PPTX/templates distilled into reusable style/layout descriptions? Identify the pipeline, intermediate artifacts, model prompts, and validation steps.
How does the system choose or route content into a layout/style? Distinguish deterministic routing from model judgement.
How does it preview/approve one visual sample before full-deck generation, and how is consistency preserved afterward?
How does it represent and enforce cross-slide variation / anti-repetition / deck rhythm, if at all?
How are visual generations versioned, edited, regenerated, rolled back, and visually reviewed? Which ideas are portable to bounded-asset or editable-object workflows?
What visual QA is genuinely machine-derived or render-derived versus prompt guidance or human judgement?
Which parts of its visual intelligence remain useful if full-slide images are forbidden as semantic source-of-truth?
Which parts should ppt-hybrid-lab explicitly reject because they depend on rasterizing semantics, post-hoc reconstruction, or unconstrained generated text?

Propose a clean-room Stage 4 schema for: (a) deck style profile, (b) composition archetype registry, (c) slide Visual IR, and (d) visual QA contract. Every proposed field should be linked to direct evidence, inference, or recommendation.
Critique our likely design mistake of treating page layouts as fixed templates. Based on this repository, identify where a reusable layout is a grammar/constraint system versus a frozen composition.
Name exact follow-up paths/symbols if the bounded context is insufficient.
expected_output: Executive summary with the 5-10 most portable Stage 4 ideas
DIRECT EVIDENCE table with path/symbol/field citations
RECOMMENDATION section mapped to ppt-hybrid-lab Visual IR/style/archetype design
Open questions / exact follow-up source needs
